name: /save
description: Draft a local narrative save and prepare its guarded recording request; not a checkpoint

steps.action: Draft a rich local narrative save in chat memory only
steps.context:
Use the current conversation facts and read-only Git evidence to prepare a comprehensive narrative in chat. Do not create a draft file in /tmp or anywhere else.

Read-only fact gathering may include:
  git branch --show-current
  git status --porcelain | wc -l
  git log --since='24 hours ago' --format='%h %s' | head -10

=== EVENT FORMAT ===

# Narrative save — {YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM}

## What was accomplished
(5-10 concrete, evidence-backed bullet points)

## Decisions made
(2-6 specific architectural choices, trade-offs, and reasons)

## Code state
- Branch: {branch}
- Uncommitted files: {count}
- Key files touched: {comma-separated list}
- Tests: {pass count if known, or 'not run'}

## What's next
(2-4 immediate next actions)

## Conversation patterns
(2-5 honest observations that could improve future work)

Present the complete draft in chat. A later recording request must bind the immutable content digest, byte size, exact local event and generated-context paths, work-item revision, reservation, registered executor, expiry, and one-time capability before either path is created or changed.

options: A) Keep the narrative in chat only
B) Request a one-time guarded local-event recording capability

steps.context: If A, stop with no repository write. If B, identify the exact event and generated-context target paths, work-item revision, executor, and proposed content needed for the capability. Do not call create_event.sh until a registered guard can accept that capability. Never synchronize automatically.
